fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Needed to order events and perform time-based detection and correlation.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify which endpoint or server generated the event.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Canonical type of source that produced the event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish Windows, Linux, and network telemetry during detection and investigation.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category of the event such as authentication, process, file, network, or audit.
fields.justification: Needed by detection rules and triage filters to group events independently of source-specific event identifiers.

source_mapping.network_csv: event type or protocol mapping table
source_mapping.network_json: event type or protocol mapping table

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity level assigned to the event.
fields.justification: Needed to prioritize suspicious events during automated detection and analyst triage.

source_mapping.windows_json: event_data severity or derived from event_id
source_mapping.linux_text: parsed_fields severity or derived from event type
source_mapping.network_csv: severity or derived from event type
source_mapping.network_json: severity or derived from event type

fields.name: user
fields.description: Account associated with the event when an account can be identified.
fields.justification: Needed to determine which user account performed or was targeted by an activity.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name of the process associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to detect suspicious process execution and support process-based investigation.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Numeric process identifier associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to correlate process activity across related events on the same host.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IPv4 or IPv6 address associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the origin of network connections and support network-based detections.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source network port associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish network services and identify suspicious connection patterns.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IPv4 or IPv6 address associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the destination of network activity and support network-based detections.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination network port associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify targeted services and detect suspicious network connections.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network protocol associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish protocols during network detections and investigation.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Source-specific identifier assigned to the original event.
fields.justification: Needed to preserve vendor-specific identity for precise detection rules and investigation.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Logical logging channel or subsystem that generated the event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish security, system, PowerShell, Sysmon, and other event streams.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Software or logging provider responsible for generating the event.
fields.justification: Needed to retain source-specific context when multiple providers produce similar event categories.

fields.name: command_line
fields.description: Process command line associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to detect suspicious arguments, scripts, encoded commands, and LOLBin execution.

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed_fields cmd or command or null

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: Filesystem path associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify suspicious files, persistence locations, and accessed resources.

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed_fields name or path or null

fields.name: message
fields.description: Normalized human-readable message describing the event.
fields.justification: Needed to provide analysts with a concise event description without requiring source-specific parsing.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original unmodified message or raw event content from the source.
fields.justification: Needed to preserve forensic context and allow analysts to validate normalized fields against the original evidence.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Indicates whether the event originated from the evidence pack or student telemetry.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish supplied evidence from analyst-generated telemetry during investigation and validation.

fields.name: parsed_fields
fields.description: Source-specific fields retained after intermediate parsing.
fields.justification: Needed to preserve useful source details that do not have a dedicated normalized field.
